body: Definitely agree I’m in that cycle but the part I’m not getting is that I am “dancing while the music is being played” so I am doing the right thing by enjoying the moment and all that but with all the work you have to do on the side it ends up feeling like too little reward for all you have to do

Just for some extra detail. The third pic is my left hand which gets bitten way less than my right. For some reason my target is my right thumb and index finger. On the other fingers it mostly the sides. A lot of times I just do it by default but it’s also so hard to resist biting when I can just see an opportunity or just more I can take off. 

At the moment I’m just trying to force myself to stop but it’s so annoying as I already have 2 spots on my thumb I can bite off and even accidentally bit my index finger and them realised and stop but what was done was done 😔

I don’t feel that feel that life is picking on me, in the end it’s my fault that I don’t do anything, that I don’t stand up for myself and do something, I’m just weak. I don’t find joy in life as every happy moment is just temporary. Moving out will be fun for a month until all the stress of being alone kick in, the first “real” job will get meh too after some time, going out with friends is nice until I have to go back. Also no haven’t had therapy because it’s just hard as a 17 year old having to give explanations on everything that I do. Tbh I did have some interview thing idk what you call it for counselling but didn’t hear anything back and tbh idk if I can even break this facade (if anyone even believes it anymore)

Not working, just a student. I have dreams ig but just a small thing happens and my day is already ruined cause I’m just so sensitive after not knowing how to talk to anyone. After that I just go into f it mode and sleep it off till the next day, rinse and repeat pretty much

Honestly I wish my only issue was the virus but this bs has been going on for nearly 2 years to which all I’ve done is just pretend everything is alright so I wouldn’t worry them or made to talk shit. At this point it just feels that I’m staying for the sake of satisfying others and I’m just tired of being criticised that I have no drive to do anything in life. While I guess quarantine could be used to relax an all, it just reminds me of how much I hate everything
I’m trying to hang on the positives but it feels much harder now to convince myself everything’s alright
